environment: Local AI26 API, nine configured recorded/replay sources actively processing, shared 2 FPS budget
method: Concurrent conditional GETs to /api/preview/CAM-01..09; compare ETags before and after the named interval
change: Camera wall preview poll interval changed from 3,000 ms to 5,000 ms. This reduces per-visible-tile request frequency by 40% and approximately matches the 4.5-second average per-camera scheduling interval when nine feeds share 2 FPS.
limitations: Only one short local sample per interval; camera scheduling was not randomized or controlled for competing work.
ETag equality shows the image bytes did not change, but does not directly measure browser paint cost, user-perceived latency, INP, or dropped playback frames.
Recorded/replay behavior does not establish live-camera timing or performance on slower hardware.
